name: podgo-web
description: Local, offline POD Go editor and read-only core test harness.

scripts.wasm: cargo build --manifest-path wasm/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/podgo_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir src/wasm
scripts.predev: npm run wasm && npm run fixtures
scripts.prebuild: npm run wasm && npm run fixtures
